ns2:section.sectionText: In this course we focus on representations of women created by women within popular culture, primarily in the MENA region and also other predominantly Muslim societies and diaspora communities. Academic and journalistic texts, images, videos, social media profiles and music will be critiqued for how they present the complexity of women’s roles and identities. Through readings, discussions, and a final project, students will seek to answer: What does it mean to be a woman in the modern Middle East or to be a Muslim woman in the world today? How are women’s various social, religious, and civic identities negotiated on a daily basis? How are women’s representations in popular culture and self-representations being read and received by local and global audiences?
